canonical_title: NVIDIA pauses revenue-sharing AI cloud financing deals
aliases: Nvidia pauses AI cloud revenue sharing deals
Nvidia AI cloud financing initiative pause
treatment: Treat the reported pause of some revenue-sharing AI-cloud financing deals as covered. Keep separate from the $500B institutional compute-financing platform unless NVIDIA formally merges the programs.
known_facts: Reuters relayed a Wall Street Journal report that NVIDIA paused some deals under a financing initiative for smaller AI cloud companies.
The model offered credit support and a guaranteed buyer for unsold compute capacity in exchange for a share of cloud revenue generated using NVIDIA hardware.
The Journal reported regulatory and control concerns, including proposed restrictions on approved renters and terms under which NVIDIA could receive 50% of revenue above a threshold.
NVIDIA said the broader business model remains in place and continues to evolve.
reinclude_only_if: NVIDIA resumes, cancels or materially restructures the revenue-sharing program.
Formal deal documents or named counterparties reveal binding economic terms.
Regulators open a formal review or enforcement action tied to the program.
notes: NEW in the 2026-08-28 Midday window. This is distinct from the institutional $500B compute-financing platform already tracked elsewhere.
